title: Why Super Shoes Keep Breaking The Marathon Record
hook: Your shoes just broke the marathon record: 2 hours flat, still falling.
closing: Somewhere, a shoe lab just shaved off more seconds.
question: Should super shoes count toward world records?

segments.say: The marathon world record has dropped to about 120 minutes.
Before super shoes, the record slipped just 8 seconds a year; then it sped up fast.
Three out of four of the fastest marathons ever came after super shoes arrived.
